type.html:
02 / Type

Cal Sans, set big and tight. DM Sans for reading. Mono for labels and numbers.

Display · Cal Sans
220 / 0.88 / −4%
Add. Remove.
H1 · 96 / 0.95
Websites for Perth businesses.
H2 · 64 / 1.0
Less fluff, more phone calls.
H3 · 40 / 1.05
We take things away for a living.
H4 · 28 / 1.1
Quote in 48 hours, not 48 emails.
Large · DM Sans 20 / 1.45
A Perth studio that builds websites at the level of the best east coast agencies, with fixed prices.
Body · DM Sans 16 / 1.5
Every site is custom-built with usability, speed and conversion in mind, so visitors can find what they need and take action. You own it, and you can edit it yourself.
Small · DM Sans 14
Prices are AUD, ex GST. Fixed-price quotes. Reply within 1 business day.
Mono · 12 / +4%
Perth 12:45pm · Concept project · 01 / Discover
